Question Choices: What is a histogram?  (A) A graph that shows exact individual data values.   (B) A graph that shows how data is grouped into intervals (buckets).   (C) A graph that only shows the largest number
Solution: B   -> A histogram groups data into ranges (like 0–29, 30–59) and shows how many values fall in each group.

Question Choices: What are "buckets" in a histogram?  (A) The tallest bars in the graph.    (B) The total number of data points.   (C) Groups or intervals of data values
Solution: C   -> Buckets are intervals (ranges) like 30-59 that group data together instead of listing exact values.
